abstract: Online replay of verifier-approved responses is a natural way to stabilize small-model RLVR, but its effect can be mistaken for a capability gain. We run a fixed 210-question, 512-token continuation from two independently trained Qwen3-0.6B-Base warm checkpoints. The replay arm stores the shortest verified response per question and adds 0.1 times its summed negative log likelihood before the ordinary global clip and AdamW step. On seed 31415, replay reaches 90/210 held-out validation items versus 74/210 for ordinary single-question training (+7.62 percentage points, paired item-bootstrap 95% CI [+1.90,+13.33]). The pre-fixed seed-27182 replication reverses the result: replay reaches 61/210 versus 84/210 ordinary (-10.95 points, CI [-17.14,-4.76]), with greedy length falling from 633 to 395 tokens. Fixed greedy MATH-500 evaluation gives 224/500 replay versus 207/500 ordinary on seed 31415, but 176/500 replay versus 219/500 ordinary on seed 27182. A separate ordinary eight-question accumulation control reaches 90/210 validation and 236/500 MATH-500 on seed 31415, matching replay validation and exceeding the 229/500 warm MATH-500 score by 7 items; its paired item interval includes zero. The fixed seed-27182 batch replication reaches 64/210 validation and 200/500 MATH-500, below its warm and ordinary validation endpoints and its ordinary MATH-500 endpoint. These two runs do not support a stable replay improvement claim and support reporting acquisition, retention, regression, output length and auxiliary-gradient dominance. We release fixed schedules, records, source hashes and a CPU checker. The study is limited to two seeds and one replay weight; item intervals do not estimate seed uncertainty.

change_summary: Release 3,500 compact MATH-500 item records, evaluator-only targets, exact configs and transcript hashes; make both paired-analysis scripts runnable directly on the supplement; fix stale format-audit language, distinguish current gradients from AdamW updates, make initial optimizer restarts and absent seed-27182 warm MATH-500 explicit, restore the exact released batch-control bootstrap interval, and correct reference titles. Clarify mixed BF16/FP32 storage and training-versus-evaluation extraction, citing the updated parameterization audit. No new training results.
title: Verified self-replay is seed-unstable under broad RLVR continuation
